description: Native GRAM coin balance of a TON address (GRAM is the renamed Toncoin; the network is still called TON). Use when: the question is about the native coin only. For token balances (USDT and other jettons) use get_jetton_balance; for deployment status, code flags and the last transaction use get_account_state. Returns: balance_gram (decimal string, e.g. "12.5"), balance_nano (string, 1 GRAM = 1e9 nano) and at_seqno — the masterchain block the reading is anchored to. Never-funded (uninitialized) addresses return 0 — that is not an error.

address.description: TON address in friendly (EQ…/UQ…) or raw (0:… / -1:…) form
